scene: Tracing the line unlocks three clattering transport docks along the breezy rooftop.
picture: Side-scrolling view along the rooftop platform. The player in his burnt-orange jacket, beanie, prosthetic leg, and telescope stands centre by the mosaic star pedestal. At the far left, a brass bridge crawler idles on railing tracks. Hanging up high centre is a yellow gondola basket. At the far right sits a red mail train.
shown: a sturdy brass crawler vehicle docked on tracks at the far left
a suspended yellow window-cleaner basket with open gate hanging up high
a sleek red mail train idling at the platform on the far right
